test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Personal care products can also been made from agricultural ingredients, such as flower or fruit extracts and oils.

options.text: such as flower or fruit extracts and oils.
also been made from agricultural ingredients,

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **error in the sentence is in part 4)** "also been made from agricultural ingredients,".
 
• In the incorrect sentence, the verb** "been"** is used** incorrectly.**
 
• **"Been" **is the past participle of "be" and is typically used in the perfect tenses.
 
• Here, the **present simple tense is appropriate**, so we should use the base form of the verb **"be".**

Therefore, the **correct sentence **should be:* "Personal care products can also **be** made from agricultural ingredients, such as flower or fruit extracts and oils."*
